title: Wordle
desc: Guess the hidden word. After each try the colours show: green is in the right place, yellow is in the word but somewhere else, grey is not in the word. Write umlauts as AE, OE and UE, and ß as SS.

config.tries_next: The new number of tries applies from the next word.

status.daily_done: A new word of the day comes tomorrow.
